description: FREE headline breaking-change pre-check of one submitted document pair (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Submit two versions of one API-surface document (OpenAPI 3.0.x/3.1.x JSON, or a standalone JSON Schema pair); get the headline only: whether the pair can be graded, the census, the verdict line, and the count of recorded changes per class. Located findings are in the paid report. The check is a deterministic mechanical comparison of the two documents you submitted — it does not establish that an upgrade will break, or will not break, any code.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

pairs.description: Alternative multi-pair form: an array of {version_a, version_b} pairs; each pair is charged at $0.02 on the paid endpoint. Mutually exclusive in effect with the single-pair version_a/version_b fields.

version_a.description: Version A of the API-surface document: an OpenAPI 3.0.x/3.1.x document in JSON form, or a standalone JSON Schema document (draft-07, 2019-09, or 2020-12). Submitted content is processed in memory only and never stored.

version_b.description: Version B of the same API-surface document, in the same form as version A. Submitted content is processed in memory only and never stored.

name: apidiff_precheck
